name: 权杖-Ⅱ
description: 黄金时代的工匠们曾将占星与炼金并列为同一门学问的两种语言。于是他们以火焰为芯，以螺纹为骨，铸成了权杖。现在只有极少量留存下来。
descriptionEn: In the golden age, artisans ranked astrology and alchemy as two languages of the same discipline. Thus they forged the scepter with flame as its core and threads as its bones. Only a tiny number survive to this day.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 离子震荡
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能位于3号位时威力+40，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; if this skill is in slot 3, power +40; transmission 1.

skills.name: 杠杆置换
skills.description: 自己回复2能量，交换两侧技能位置。
skills.descriptionEn: Restore 2 energy; swap the positions of adjacent skills.

skills.name: 械斗
skills.description: 造成物伤，本技能位于1号位时威力+60，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if in slot 1, power +60; transmission 1.

skills.name: 磁暴
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能位于1号或3号位时威力+30，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; if in slot 1 or 3, power +30; transmission 1.

skills.name: 无畏之心
skills.description: 减伤100%，应对攻击：减免的伤害变为回复自己生命，且本技能能耗永久+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduce damage 100%; respond to attacks: damage avoided becomes healing to self, and this skill's energy cost permanently +2.

skills.name: 钢铁洪流
skills.description: 造成物伤，本技能位于1号位时威力+90，传动2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if in slot 1, power +90; transmission 2.

skills.name: 啮合传递
skills.description: 自己获得速度+30，本技能位于1号或3号位时额外获得物攻+80%，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Gain speed +30; if in slot 1 or 3, additionally gain attack +80%; transmission 1.

skills.name: 彗星
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每失去5%生命，本次技能威力-10，使用后消耗全部生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for every 5% HP lost, power -10; after use, consumes all HP.

skills.name: 轴承支撑
skills.description: 主动：本技能被动永久额外-1能耗，被动：两侧技能能耗-1，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Active: this skill's passive permanently -1 energy cost; passive: adjacent skills' energy cost -1; transmission 1.

skills.name: 联动装置
skills.description: 使用后两侧技能的威力永久+20，应对防御：变为威力永久+30。
skills.descriptionEn: After use, adjacent skills' power permanently +20; respond to defense: becomes power permanently +30.
